svg.title: Anatomy of a notch filter: centre frequency, bandwidth, Q, depth, and its poles and zeros
svg.desc: Gain in decibels against frequency for two second-order notch filters centred on 50 hertz. The Q = 2 notch is wide: its gain is 3 dB down at about 39 and 64 hertz, a bandwidth of 25 hertz, so Q = 50 / 25 = 2. The Q = 10 notch is five times narrower. Both fall to minus infinity at exactly 50 hertz, the depth. An inset shows the digital version on the z-plane: two zeros on the unit circle at the notch frequency and two poles just inside them; moving the poles closer to the zeros narrows the notch.

g.text: zeros on the circle: f₀ removed
